create.name: Sarah Divine
create.bio:
Sarah Divine has taught qigong since 2015 and is one of White Tiger Qigong's most senior teachers. She is a Level 6 Senior Instructor certified in every one of the school's systems, and she serves as its Assistant Academic Director, helping shape the global curriculum and train new instructors. She holds a Master's degree in Sport and Exercise Science. Her teaching combines Daoist medical qigong and Chinese medicine principles with fascia research, biomechanics, breathwork and nervous-system regulation.

In Adelaide, she is known for taking her practice outdoors. She runs weekly groups in the city's Park Lands, at Veale Gardens and Hurtle Square/Tangkaira, where passers-by often stop to join in. She also teaches live classes on Zoom, runs workshops and multi-week courses, offers private one-to-one training, and leads seasonal retreats. Her teaching is careful and compassionate, and focuses on helping students move more freely, settle stress and practise safely.
